recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If future review finds a problem with the migrated ShareableValueSet definition, handle it in the repository that owns the CRMI/terminology profile content rather than in FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-8908 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request for FHIR-core ValueSet asking that the ShareableValueSet profile explicitly state the extensions in use.
initial_application: The R5 PR 2068 implementation commit 93fadfaa2a explicitly cites J#8908 and adds explicit extension slices for cqf-knowledgeRepresentationLevel and valueset-authoritativeSource to source/valueset/structuredefinition-profile-shareablevalueset.xml, while also registering the ValueSet profiles in the ValueSet core ImplementationGuide.
additional_context: FHIR-31395 was implemented in the same PR 2068 profile-update family. The later Applied/Persuasive R6 decision FHIR-37959 resolved to remove the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable profiles from FHIR core and maintain them going forward in CRMI, with their URIs unchanged; May 2025 TI/CDS-CQI minutes support that profile-location decision. Current source has an empty ValueSet core IG definition and no active fhir.ini profile entry for ShareableValueSet.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because restoring or modifying the old core ShareableValueSet profile would conflict with FHIR-37959 and would touch an out-of-build artifact.
